title: Bubble Bath for Dinosaurs
subtitle: Never bring a squeaky duck
style: flat hand-drawn illustration on speckled cream paper with tiny grey flecks, the speckled paper fills the whole square picture edge to edge with no border, simple flat colour shapes with thin wobbly outlines, muted faded colours: rusty red, soft pink, pale yellow, soft green and grey-blue, ordinary objects drawn plain, without eyes or faces, the upper third of the picture left as empty speckled paper, no words, no letters and no writing anywhere in the picture

pages.zh:
嘿，小朋友。
你知道恐龙最爱干什么吗？
pages.scene: A small old bathtub full of foam standing alone, the tip of a dinosaur tail sticking up out of the bubbles
pages.en:
Hey, kid.
Do you know what dinosaurs love most?

pages.zh: 不是吼。
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face standing with its mouth closed in a flat line and its eyes half closed, looking sleepy and bored, arms hanging, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en: Not roaring.

pages.zh: 不是跑。
pages.scene: One very tall long-necked grey-blue dinosaur with a tiny head, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face standing completely still and yawning, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en: Not running.

pages.zh: 是泡泡浴。
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face sitting in an old bathtub with foam up to its chin, eyes closed, blissful, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en: It's bubble baths.

pages.zh:
恐龙泡澡之前，
一定会先用脚趾头
试一试水温。
脚趾头说：「可以。」
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face happily jumping into a bathtub with its knees tucked up and its eyes squeezed shut, a big splash of water flying everywhere, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
Before a dinosaur gets in the bath,
it always tests the water
with one toe first.
The toe says, “Okay.”

pages.zh: 大概试了吧。
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face sitting in a nearly empty bathtub in a flooded bathroom, water all over the floor, looking at the viewer with a plain face
pages.en: Probably.

pages.zh:
三角龙喜欢把泡泡
堆在三只角上。
洗澡也要戴帽子。
pages.scene: One small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face in a bathtub with tall piles of foam stacked on its three horns, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
Triceratops likes to pile bubbles
on all three horns.
Even in the bath, it wears a hat.

pages.zh:
长脖子恐龙要用三个浴缸。
一个泡脑袋，
一个泡肚子，
一个泡尾巴。
它说：「分开洗，洗得干净。」
pages.scene: One very tall long-necked grey-blue dinosaur with a tiny head, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face lying stretched across three bathtubs in a row, its long neck bending down so its head rests in the first bathtub, its round belly in the middle one and its long tail in the last one, eyes closed, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
The long-neck needs three bathtubs.
One for its head,
one for its belly,
and one for its tail.
It says, “One part at a time. Extra clean.”

pages.zh:
剑龙背上的板子，
正好用来晾毛巾。
它说：「我的背，就是毛巾架。」
pages.scene: One pink stegosaurus with wobbly plates along its back, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face standing beside a bathtub with towels hanging over the plates on its back, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
The plates on Stegosaurus's back
are perfect for drying towels.
It says, “My back is a towel rack.”

pages.zh:
霸王龙的手太短了，
搓不到背。
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face sitting alone in a bathtub of foam, stretching one tiny arm over its shoulder towards its back and not reaching, a puzzled plain face, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
T. rex's arms are too short
to scrub its back.

pages.zh:
它试过用树枝。
树枝说：「我不干了。」
咔嚓。
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face standing in a bathtub holding the two halves of a snapped branch, one half in each tiny hand, looking at them with a plain face, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
It tried a stick.
The stick said, “I quit.”
Snap.

pages.zh:
它试过在墙上蹭。
墙说：「你太重了。」
轰。
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face leaning its back against a garden wall, the wall tipping over behind it and its bricks tumbling down, the T. rex looking back over its shoulder with a plain face, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
It tried rubbing on a wall.
The wall said, “You're too heavy.”
BOOM.

pages.zh:
所以，你要是想请恐龙来家里，
就放一大缸泡泡水。
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts pouring a big bottle of bubble bath into a large bathtub, no dinosaurs in the picture
pages.en:
So if you want dinosaurs to come over,
run a great big tub of bubbles.

pages.zh:
泡泡越多，
它们来得越快。
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts half buried in foam that overflows a bathtub and fills the whole bathroom, no dinosaurs in the picture
pages.en:
The more bubbles,
the faster they come.

pages.zh:
不过，有一件事，
你一定、一定要记住。
pages.scene: Close-up of one small yellow rubber duck sitting alone on a bathroom floor of white tiles, nothing else in the picture
pages.en:
But there is one thing
you must never, ever forget.

pages.zh:
千万不能放
会叫的小黄鸭。
pages.scene: One small yellow rubber duck on a bathroom floor in front, and far behind it one small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face hiding behind a towel and peeking out nervously
pages.en:
Never, ever put in
a rubber duck that squeaks.

pages.zh:
恐龙什么都不怕。
不怕打雷，不怕黑。
打针？它说：「来吧。」
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face sitting calmly on a hill under a dark stormy sky with lightning, completely unbothered, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
Dinosaurs aren't afraid of anything.
Not thunder, not the dark.
A shot at the doctor's? It says, “Go ahead.”

pages.zh:
就怕那一声……
吱。
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face frozen stiff in surprise, staring at one small yellow rubber duck on the ground in front of it
pages.en:
Except that one sound…
SQUEAK.

pages.zh:
恐龙一听见，
就会吓得跳起来。
一跳，就有三层楼那么高。
pages.scene: Four dinosaurs: a big green T. rex with tiny arms, a small round ochre triceratops, a very tall long-necked grey-blue dinosaur and a pink stegosaurus all leaping high up into the air in fright, far above the roof of a house far below them, eyes wide, little motion lines under their feet
pages.en:
When a dinosaur hears it,
it jumps in fright.
One jump—as high as three houses!

pages.zh:
所以，小黄鸭，
放到别的地方去。
放高一点。
再高一点。
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts standing on tiptoe on a stool, putting a small yellow rubber duck on top of a very tall wardrobe, no dinosaurs in the picture
pages.en:
So put the rubber duck
somewhere else.
Up high.
Higher.

pages.zh:
星期六晚上，
你办了一个泡泡浴派对。
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts standing at a bathroom door welcoming four dinosaurs: a big green T. rex with tiny arms, a small round ochre triceratops, a very tall long-necked grey-blue dinosaur and a pink stegosaurus, a bathtub full of foam behind
pages.en:
On Saturday night,
you throw a bubble bath party.

pages.zh:
恐龙都来了。
浴缸说：「有点挤。」
pages.scene: Four dinosaurs: a big green T. rex with tiny arms, a small round ochre triceratops, a very tall long-necked grey-blue dinosaur and a pink stegosaurus all squeezed together into one bathtub full of foam, looking squashed with plain faces
pages.en:
All the dinosaurs come.
The bathtub says, “It's a little crowded.”

pages.zh: 挤了很多点。
pages.scene: A small bathroom so crammed with four dinosaurs: a big green T. rex with tiny arms, a small round ochre triceratops, a very tall long-necked grey-blue dinosaur and a pink stegosaurus and foam that dinosaur tails and heads stick out of the door and the window
pages.en: A lot more than a little.

pages.zh:
大家泡得眯起了眼睛。
舒服极了。
pages.scene: Four dinosaurs: a big green T. rex with tiny arms, a small round ochre triceratops, a very tall long-necked grey-blue dinosaur and a pink stegosaurus soaking in a big bathtub of foam with their eyes closed, blissful, and a small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts fully dressed, sitting on a little stool beside the tub
pages.en:
Everyone soaks with their eyes half closed.
So cozy.

pages.zh:
可是，谁也没有发现，
泡泡底下，
漂着一只小黄鸭。
pages.scene: Close-up of a bathtub filled to the brim with white foam, one small yellow rubber duck half hidden among the white bubbles, white bathroom tiles behind, nothing else in the picture
pages.en:
But nobody notices
that under the bubbles,
a little rubber duck is floating.

pages.zh: 霸王龙往后一靠——
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face leaning back contentedly in a bathtub full of foam, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en: T. rex leans back—

pages.zh: 吱！
pages.scene: A small yellow rubber duck squashed flat under a T. rex, and one big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face looking surprised
pages.en: SQUEAK!

pages.zh:
恐龙全跳起来了！
泡泡飞出窗户，飞满客厅，
一直涨到天花板。
pages.scene: A cosy living room with a sofa and a lamp buried in fluffy white foam right up to the ceiling, dinosaur tails and horns poking out of the white foam here and there
pages.en:
All the dinosaurs jump!
Bubbles fly out the window, fill the living room,
and pile up to the ceiling.

pages.zh:
你在泡泡里摸呀摸，
摸到了那只小黄鸭。
放进抽屉，关好。
咔哒。
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts standing in foam putting a small yellow rubber duck into a drawer and closing it firmly, no dinosaurs in the picture
pages.en:
You feel around in the bubbles
and find that rubber duck.
Into the drawer. Shut tight.
Click.

pages.zh:
最后，你拿来一把长长的刷子，
帮霸王龙搓了背。
它说：「左边一点。」
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts standing on a stool scrubbing the back of one big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face with a long-handled brush, the T. rex with eyes closed in bliss
pages.en:
Then you get a long, long brush
and scrub T. rex's back.
It says, “A little to the left.”

pages.zh:
泡泡慢慢落了下来。
大家都睡着了。
pages.scene: Four dinosaurs: a big green T. rex with tiny arms, a small round ochre triceratops, a very tall long-necked grey-blue dinosaur and a pink stegosaurus fast asleep with their eyes closed, curled up in and around a bathtub with a little foam left, the bathroom calm and quiet
pages.en:
The bubbles slowly settle down.
Everyone falls asleep.

pages.zh:
现在你知道了：
恐龙爱泡泡浴，怕会叫的鸭子，
还有，它们都搓不到背。
今天晚上洗澡的时候，你也看看，
泡泡里有没有一只小恐龙。
pages.scene: A small bathtub full of foam with one tiny dinosaur head peeking out of the bubbles, looking at the viewer
pages.en:
Now you know:
dinosaurs love bubble baths, are scared of squeaky ducks,
and not one of them can reach its own back.
Tonight at bath time, take a look—
is there a little dinosaur in your bubbles?
